JVM internals for Kotlin and Android developers

Trace a tiny bookmark program from compiled instructions to method frames, shared objects and reachability.

Course outline

  • From source to a live object4 puzzles

    Follow the same counter through four experiments.

    1. Which program did you actually run? Follow a source edit into the file the runtime reads.
    2. What does a method receive? Track one number across a call and back.
    3. Why do both names read eight? Predict which changes survive a method call.
    4. When can a counter be reclaimed? Trace which object the remaining variable can reach.
    Check what you already know
  • Changing shared state1 puzzles

    A change applied only when the current value matches the expected value.

    1. How can two increments produce eight? Follow two callers that both read seven before either saves.
    Check what you already know

Final project

Explain one run from class file to shared counter · Trace a small program before running it. Defend which values belong to method frames, which objects remain reachable and which concurrent schedules lose an increment.

How the course works

Start by tracing one tiny program. Use the browser workbench to predict what changes in a frame or on the heap. Then use a local JDK to compare the model with compiled instructions and run the shared-counter exercise.

Every puzzle is open from this outline. The check at the end of a puzzle unlocks its next button and saves your progress in this browser.
